name: Followers of Set of Note (Wolves at the Door Lore)

text.content: Once caliph of Cairo and a natural target for Setite manipulation given his position, al-Hakim instead fell under the sway of the Malkavians and now serves as their ghoul, mad among the mad. The @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.ssX4b2JFXF2uegC3]{Followers of Set} initially welcomed the prospect — reasoning that a madman would be all the easier to steer — but every overture toward him instead produced wild, unpredictable results, culminating in vicious persecutions against the Setites and the wider Egyptian population alike. Setite elders now consider al-Hakim more trouble than he is worth and privately favor his destruction, though few among the clan can resist the temptation to test their wits against him and his @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.ZJx9H3XnU8yQGy9s]{Malkavian} keepers. Storytellers can use al-Hakim as an unpredictable wildcard in Cairo politics: a nominal figure of great mortal authority whose true masters and motives are impossible for outsiders to read.
